nom: Black Girl Sunscreen Make It Matte Sunscreen - SPF 45

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some describing it as extremely oily, report the matte finish controls shine well through the day; a few with oily or combination skin, however, find it not matte enough, describing a dewy finish or ongoing greasiness, particularly in hot weather.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report reduced shine and no new breakouts, though one reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports her face stays oily and greasy and summer breakouts persist despite using it.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: some report no irritation even alongside conditions like melasma or eczema, while others report tingling, stinging around the eyes, breakouts, or, in one case, a severe allergic photocontact reaction with swelling and blistering attributed to the octocrylene ingredient.
segments.mature: One reviewer who describes herself as older and using prescription menopause skincare (estrogen and tretinoin creams) reports the sunscreen leaves her skin feeling soft with a natural glow, without the chalky white residue she got from other brands.

concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some managing cystic or hormonal acne, report no new breakouts over months of use, and a couple credit consistent use with existing blemishes and marks fading faster. Others, particularly with combination or acne-prone skin, report new or persistent breakouts, especially in warm weather.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with hyperpigmentation, melasma, or discoloration report their tone evening out and dark marks fading with regular use, consistent with sun protection preventing further darkening; no reviewer in this set reports the sunscreen itself causing new spots.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers with oily skin report the matte finish keeps shine controlled through the day, including some describing their skin as extremely oily. A sizeable minority, however, report the product feels or looks greasy, leaves a dewy rather than matte finish, or stops looking matte by the end of the day, especially in heat or humidity.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation, including some managing eczema. A recurring smaller group reports stinging or burning specifically around the eyes, and separately, isolated reports describe tingling, breakouts, or, in one case, a severe allergic photocontact reaction with swelling and blistering linked to the octocrylene ingredient.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers generally describe the sunscreen as leaving skin feeling moisturized and soft rather than dry; no reviewer in this set reports it causing dryness.

aspects.libelle: No white cast on deeper skin tones
Doubles well as a makeup primer
Small tube lasts a long time
Can be hard to rub in or slow to absorb

extraits.texte: I developed really bad photocontact dermatitis when I wore this in the sun. Severe swelling, blisters, red and crusty, itchy skin. Octocrylene ingredient is known irritant apparently. Stick to mineral sunscreens.

extraits.titre: Not for sensitive or oily skin
extraits.texte: Let's start with the positives. As a Black woman I like that this sunscreen doesn't leave a white overcast on my skin. The gel formula is also thick and creates a smooth surface for makeup. I wanted to love this product but just threw it away due to breakouts! I typically have clear skin and since using this product I have had several breakouts. I suffer from hyperpigmentation so I'm not looking forward to recovering from this acne. I have sensitive skin and there's a 50/50 chance my face would tingle after applying. I just started using a new toner so wanted to see which product was causing this reaction, and it's the sunscreen. In the first paragraph I mentioned how the formula creates a smooth foundation for makeup. However, this sunscreen would leave me face SUPER GREASY! I've never had to blot so much even when I didn't follow up with makeup (which is most days). This product separates and I wasn't aware that I had to shake it the first few days. I was basically applying an oily liquid to my face (when I got the first big breakout). Despite shaking the product and getting the actual correct consistency, I'm still breaking out.

extraits.titre: I really wanted to like it
extraits.texte: I love supporting black owned businesses especially in skin care. quite often our skin is not considered with product formulation. I would much rather spend my money with a company that's being intentional. with that said I love the clear application. never an issue with a white cast. goes well as a first layer before makeup and no pilling. downsides are for me as someone with combination skin and acne prone I do not do well with this sunscreen especially in the summertime. my face just kind of stays oily and greasy. for someone with dry skin or who isn't acne prone it would probably appear as a nice glow for them. for me it's just greasy and I feel like my summer breakouts never go away. so if you have the right skin type this could be a great SPF for you. if you're acne prone with combo skin I recommend to keep looking.

My skin is super sensitive. I have combination skin. I also have hormonal Melasma. This sunscreen is the only one that gives me the less shine and no irritation. It has been part of my daily routine for over a year now. before I was using the Make it Hybrid. I always keep 1 reserve (just in case of inventory shortage in my area).

I have cystic acne and get red at times. I get shiny a lot. I have tried every single sunscreen out there. Nothing has ever worked for me except this one. I never write reviews but had to for this. Other sunscreens make me break out and leave me white and shiny. This one I have been using now for about four months, no breakouts at all. Keeps my skin from getting shiny though out the day. I even use at night before applying my makeup to keep the shine away. It keep my powder looking good all night. I love love love this product and definitely recommend to anyone who has skin like mine. Trust me you will love it.
Confident sun protection and applied over a good oily skin moisturizer, keeps my extremely oily skin matte throughout most of the day. Easy to reapply too! This is my favorite facial sunscreen ever!
I've always used black girl sunscreen and my hyperpigmentation is much better because of it . Definitely in my skincare routine to stay 🤗
